summary.en:
- Xueyi is a four-star Break DPS. She was designed to be a hybrid CRIT and Break DPS. Going fully into Break build is better, thanks to the incredible buffs and debuffs the team has to offer.
- When dealing Toughness Reduction, Xueyi gains Karma. After reacing 8 Karma, she launches a Follow-Up ATK. This Follow-Up ATK cannot add Karma stacks. Karma can have 6 overflow stacks, up to a max of 14.

details.en:
- E1 increases the damage dealt by the Follow-Up ATK by 40%. Since most her damage comes from here, it makes it pretty good.
- E6 reduces the stacks needed to launch a Follow-Up ATK, leading to more frequent Toughness damage.
